landscapeBanner: Rotate your device for a better view of the cards
hint.declare: Your hand is a winning combination -- declare it and win now
hint.lead: Leading these together collects more points at once
tutorial.trump: The card at the bottom of the stock sets the trump suit. A trump beats any card of any other suit.
tutorial.multiCard: Cards of one suit can be led together, up to three. More points move at once -- but if the lead is beaten, all of them go to your opponent.
tutorial.beating: To take the trick you must match the lead's count and beat every card with a distinct better one. There is no obligation to follow suit, so throwing away a card you cannot win with is a real option.
tutorial.claim: 31 points only wins if you claim it yourself. Claiming when you are short loses the round immediately.
tutorial.controls: Pick cards and press Play. Once you reach 31, remember to claim.
declareHint: Declaring wins outright if your three cards are one of these (nothing happens if they are not):

combo.littleMoscow: Little Moscow: three sixes, one of them the trump six
combo.molodka: Molodka: three cards of one suit
